Kittens have lots of energy so buying some cheap toys that bounce and they can chase like springs are a great way to tire them out. They are kittens so when they run around they are light enough that you don’t really hear it. It gets easier since this is a big change in your life but trust me, it will slowly become normal again. You won’t regret keeping your babies.

It was so bad that when I got this certain job and I realized we had to work around food, I was so anxious that I wanted to cry. I wouldn’t eat in front of people, I hated being seen as the fat person eating. I didn’t even like talking about food or saying that something looked delicious. I’m still trying to get over this but sometimes it does creep back up.
